contentBlocks.text: This week you built every piece of a real capstone plan. Let's put it all together into one proposal!

Quick review: a capstone is self-directed, sustained, and independent (Day 1). A strong text choice balances interest, depth, and accessibility (Day 2). A focused research question drives real analysis (Day 3). A realistic milestone timeline prevents rushed final work (Day 4). Combine your text choice, research question, and timeline from this week into one complete capstone proposal.
Great work this week — you built a complete, real capstone project proposal! Next week we'll build on these skills with something new.

objectives: Review capstone definition, text choice, research question, and timeline planning
Combine all three into one complete written capstone proposal
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child assemble their complete capstone proposal.
3. Complete the review worksheet.
4. Celebrate finishing a real capstone project proposal, ready to begin!
differentiationTips: Struggling: it's fine if the proposal is short — focus on genuinely combining all three pieces (text, question, timeline) rather than length
Ready for more: ask the child what they're most looking forward to, or most nervous about, in actually carrying out this project
This is the week's synthesis moment — a real, usable proposal the child can genuinely follow going forward, not just a review exercise
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended synthesis activity — check that the proposal genuinely combines all three elements from this week (the chosen text with its justification, the focused research question, and the four-milestone timeline) into one coherent, usable plan.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's capstone-research-project thread before the course continues, matching the established Day-5-review pacing used across every unit this session, producing a genuinely usable final artifact rather than just a review.
